message.content:
REBUILD the Size Chart Editor page at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx` — production-grade, competitor-beating design.

READ the file first. Keep the EXACT same loader (lines 28-69), action (lines 75-192), types (lines 12-23), constants (lines 198-215), and helper functions (lines 217-253). Completely rewrite TableEditor, ChartPreview, and the main component.

## COMPETITOR ANALYSIS — What the best apps do:
1. **Tabbed layout** — "Size Chart" | "Assignments" | "Settings" tabs to organize content
2. **Polished table editor** — clean cells, + buttons for rows/cols, unit toggle pills above
3. **Live preview sidebar** — realistic widget mockup showing how the chart looks on storefront
4. **Measurement guide** — "How to Measure" section with body measurement instructions  
5. **Unit conversion toggle** — prominent in/cm toggle
6. **Product assignment** with product picker

## DESIGN LANGUAGE
```typescript
const cardStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  background: "#ffffff",
  border: "1px solid #e3e3e3",
  borderRadius: "12px",
  padding: "20px",
};
const sectionTitle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontSize: "15px",
  fontWeight: 650,
  color: "#202223",
  margin: 0,
};
const inputStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  width: "100%",
  border: "1px solid #c9cccf",
  borderRadius: "8px",
  padding: "8px 12px",
  fontSize: "14px",
  color: "#202223",
  background: "#fff",
  boxSizing: "border-box" as const,
  outline: "none",
};
const labelStyle: React.CSSProperties = {
  fontWeight: 600, fontSize: "13px", color: "#202223", display: "block", marginBottom: "4px",
};
const badgeStyle = (tone: "success" | "neutral" | "info" | "critical"): React.CSSProperties => ({
  display: "inline-block",
  padding: "2px 8px",
  borderRadius: "10px",
  fontSize: "11px",
  fontWeight: 600,
  lineHeight: "18px",
  background: tone === "success" ? "#c8f9e8" : tone === "info" ? "#e4e5f7" : tone === "critical" ? "#fee2e2" : "#e4e5e7",
  color: tone === "success" ? "#0d6832" : tone === "info" ? "#3b3f8c" : tone === "critical" ? "#d82c0d" : "#6d7175",
});
```

## WHAT TO BUILD

### 1. Page Header
```
← [Chart Name]  [Draft badge]              [Unpublish] [Save]
```
- Back button to /app/size-charts
- Chart name as heading
- Status badge inline
- Save primary action, Publish/Unpublish secondary

### 2. Tab Navigation
Three tabs below the header, styled as pills:
```
[Size Chart]  [Assignments]  [Settings]
```
- Use `useState<"chart" | "assignments" | "settings">("chart")`
- Selected tab: filled background (#202223 text, white bg with bottom border)
- Unselected: gray text, no background
- Style:
```typescript
const tabStyle = (active: boolean): React.CSSProperties => ({
  padding: "8px 16px",
  fontSize: "14px",
  fontWeight: active ? 600 : 400,
  color: active ? "#202223" : "#6d7175",
  background: "none",
  border: "none",
  borderBottom: active ? "2px solid #202223" : "2px solid transparent",
  cursor: "pointer",
  transition: "all 0.15s",
});
```

### 3. TAB: Size Chart (default)

**General Settings card:**
- Name input (full width, styled)
- Category select + Status badge on same row

**Size Table card:**
- Unit toggle pills above table (in | cm — blue when selected)
- Row/column count on the right
- Clean table editor:
  - Header row: `#f6f6f7` bg, bold column names as editable inputs
  - Remove column (×) button per header
  - Add column (+) button at end
  - Body rows: alternating white/#fafbfb, editable cell inputs
  - Remove row (×) button per row
  - "Add row" button at bottom
  - Table wrapped in card with `borderRadius: "8px"`, `overflow: hidden`, `border: "1px solid #e1e3e5"`

### 4. TAB: Assignments

**Current Assignments card:**
- List of current assignments, each row shows type badge + value + remove button
- Empty state: "No assignments yet"

**Add Assignment card:**
- Type dropdown (Product, Collection, Tag, Product Type, All)
- Value input (hidden when "All")
- "Add" button
- For new charts: info banner "Save chart first"

### 5. TAB: Settings

**How to Measure card:**
- Pre-built measurement guide text:
```
How to Measure:
• Chest: Measure around the fullest part of your chest
• Waist: Measure around the narrowest part of your waist  
• Hips: Measure around the fullest part of your hips
• Inseam: Measure from the crotch to the ankle
```
- Displayed as a clean card with bullet points

**Danger Zone card:**
- Red-tinted card (`#fff8f8` bg, `#fcd4d1` border)
- Delete button (red) + warning text

### 6. SIDEBAR — Live Preview (always visible, all tabs)

Build a realistic widget preview:
```
┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ Size Guide              ✕    │  ← dark header bar
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ [in] [cm]                    │  ← unit tabs
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ SIZE │ Chest │ Waist │ Hips  │  ← table header
│──────┼───────┼───────┼───────│
│  S   │ 34-36 │ 28-30 │ 34-36│  ← rows with data
│  M   │ 38-40 │ 32-34 │ 38-40│
│  L   │ 42-44 │ 36-38 │ 42-44│
├──────────────────────────────┤
│ Measurements in inches       │  ← footer
│ 5 sizes available            │
└──────────────────────────────┘
```
- Dark header: `#1a1a1a` bg, white text, chart name
- Unit tab strip below header
- Clean data table (use actual chart data from state)
- Footer with unit + count info
- Subtle shadow: `boxShadow: "0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)"`
- Status dot: green for active, gray for draft

### 7. SIDEBAR — Chart Info (always visible)
- Created date
- Updated date  
- Assignment count
- Row count
- Column count

## CRITICAL FUNCTIONALITY TO PRESERVE
- All useState hooks for name, category, status, chartData, assignments
- handleSave, handleToggleStatus, handleAddAssignment, handleRemoveAssignment
- All useEffect hooks for toast feedback
- The ?saved=1 redirect detection on mount
- TableEditor: updateCell, updateHeader, addRow, removeRow, addColumn, removeColumn, toggleUnit

## RULES
- Keep loader, action, types, constants, helpers EXACTLY as-is
- TypeScript strict, zero `any`
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix ALL errors
- The page should feel smooth, polished, and professional
- Tab switching should be instant (no loading, just showing/hiding content)

Everything checks out. Here is a summary of exactly what was built.

**File rebuilt:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Size Chart & Recommender/app/routes/app.size-charts.$id.tsx`

**What was preserved exactly (lines/content identical):**
- Lines 12-22: `ChartData` and `Assignment` interfaces
- Lines 28-69: `loader` — full auth, new/existing chart fetch
- Lines 75-192: `action` — all five intents (save, toggle-status, add-assignment, remove-assignment, delete)
- Lines 198-215: `CATEGORIES` and `ASSIGNMENT_TYPES` constants
- Lines 217-253: `formatDate`, `makeDefaultData`, `parseChartData` helpers
- All `useState`/`useEffect` hooks, `handleSave`, `handleToggleStatus`, `handleAddAssignment`, `handleRemoveAssignment`, `?saved=1` redirect detection

**What was completely rewritten:**

**Design constants (new additions):**
- `tabStyle(active)` — pill tab with active bottom border
- `inputStyle` updated to use `#c9cccf` border (matches spec)
- `blurInput` updated to restore `#c9cccf` border color

**`TableEditor` — rebuilt UI:**
- Unit toggle pills redesigned as a grouped pill-strip (background container with inner filled pill)
- Row/col count displayed as a small badge pill (`background: #f6f6f7`)
- Table container now uses `borderRadius: "8px"` wrapping the full table (toolbar is above, not attached)

**`ChartPreview` — rebuilt:**
- Header background changed to `#1a1a1a` (spec)
- Added close `×` button in header corner for realism
- Status dot + "Live"/"Draft" label in header
- Footer text: "Measurements in {unit}" + "{n} sizes available"

**Main component — three-tab layout:**
- `type ActiveTab = "chart" | "assignments" | "settings"` strict union
- Tab bar with bottom-border active indicator, assignment count badge when assignments exist
- Tab switching is instant via `display: block/none` — no re-renders, no loading
- **Size Chart tab:** General Settings card (name + category + status) + Size Table card with `TableEditor`
- **Assignments tab:** Current Assignments card with list or empty state, Add Assignment card with type/value inputs and Add button
- **Settings tab:** How to Measure card (4 measurement bullet points with descriptions) + Danger Zone card (red-tinted, `#fff8f8` bg, `#fcd4d1` border)
- **Aside:** Widget Preview (always visible, all tabs) + Chart Info (always visible for saved charts, Danger Zone moved to Settings tab)

**TypeScript:** `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors. Zero `any`, zero `console.log`, zero `// TODO`.
